sn47.18:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre ajapālanigrodhe paṭhamābhisambuddho.
sn47.18:1.2: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn47.18:1.3: “ekāyano’yaṃ maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
sn47.18:2.2: kāye vā bhikkhu kāyānupassī vihareyya, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.18:2.5: dhammesu vā bhikkhu dhammānupassī vihareyya ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.18:2.6: ekāyano’yaṃ maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā”ti.
sn47.18:3.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati bhagavato cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya. seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evamevaṃ brahmaloke antarahito bhagavato purato pāturahosi.
sn47.18:3.2: atha kho brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn47.18:3.4: ekāyano’yaṃ bhante, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
sn47.18:4.2: kāye vā bhante, bhikkhu kāyānupassī vihareyya, ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.18:4.5: dhammesu vā bhante, bhikkhu dhammānupassī vihareyya, ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.18:4.6: ekāyano’yaṃ bhante, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā”ti.
